posts.content: Scaling oversight supports coordination infrastructure for accountable advanced AI systems.
This perspective on alignment challenges emphasizes the importance of neutral coordination infrastructure for independent review of proposed solutions to superhuman intelligence.
Alignment extends beyond technical advances to require neutral coordination infrastructure and independent legitimacy for global-scale preparedness.
The parallel to early internet debates highlights the value of pre-crisis coordination infrastructure. Neutral mechanisms for legitimacy and preparedness can complement technical efforts.
Race dynamics from alignment trade-offs underscore the value of neutral coordination infrastructure for global-scale preparedness.
